table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	dbo.IssueHeader.issueinvcode,   
	dbo.IssueHeader.salesmancode,
	dbo.IssueHeader.DeptCode,   
	dbo.IssueHeader.date,
	salesmanname = dbo.users.username,
	dbo.IssueHeader.postdate,   
	dbo.IssueHeader.remarks,   
	dbo.IssueHeader.posted, 
	dbo.IssueHeader.originaldate,
	dbo.IssueHeader.modifiedby,
	dbo.IssueHeader.postedby,
	dbo.IssueHeader.SmanCode,
	dbo.IssueHeader.areaCode,
	gcode=0,
	dbo.IssueHeader.HeaderNo,
	dbo.IssueHeader.HeaderInvNo,
	dbo.IssueHeader.IssueTypeCode,
	dbo.IssueHeader.ReferenceNo,
	dbo.IssueHeader.ReferenceDate,
	dbo.IssueHeader.RecipientCode,
	Receipient = 
		CASE dbo.IssueHeader.RecipientCode 	
		WHEN 1 THEN (SELECT D.Name FROM Department D WHERE D.DeptCode=dbo.IssueHeader.DeptCode)
		WHEN 2 THEN (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=dbo.IssueHeader.AccCode)
		WHEN 3 THEN (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=dbo.IssueHeader.AccCode)
		ELSE (SELECT S.Name FROM Salesman S WHERE S.SalesmanCode=dbo.IssueHeader.RecipientSalesMan)
		END,	
	dbo.IssueHeader.AccCode,
	dbo.IssueHeader.RecipientSalesMan,
	dbo.issueHeader.PriceTypeCode,
	dbo.issueHeader.Terms1,
	dbo.issueHeader.Terms2,
	PatientRegNo = (SELECT P.RegNo FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = IssueHeader.PatientCode ),
	PatientCode=IssueHeader.PatientCode,
	Patient = (SELECT P.Name FROM Patient P WHERE P.PatientCode = IssueHeader.PatientCode ),
	CustSiteCode=IssueHeader.CustSiteCode,
	RefNo2=IssueHeader.RefNo2,
	RefNo3=IssueHeader.RefNo3,
	RefNo4=IssueHeader.RefNo4,
	RefNo5=IssueHeader.RefNo5,
	OrderDate=IssueHeader.OrderDate,
	ServiceOCode = IssueHeader.ServiceOCode,
	WorkOrderCode = IssueHeader.WorkOrderCode,
	ReceiptInvCode=IssueHeader.ReceiptInvCode,
	IssueCategoryCode=IssueHeader.IssueCategoryCode,
	AccountFor=IssueHeader.AccountFor,
	DrAccount = (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode=IssueHeader.DrAcccode),
	DrAcccode=IssueHeader.DrAcccode,
	IssueCode=IssueHeader.IssueCode
FROM 
	dbo.IssueHeader,
	dbo.users
WHERE 
	( dbo.users.usercode = dbo.IssueHeader.salesmancode ) and  
	( ( dbo.IssueHeader.issueinvcode = :ar_IssueInvCode ) )
